## fix skill v0.4.1

- Emphasized that `/fix` must fully resume and complete the original interrupted deliverable after correcting behavior, not just patch rules and stop.
- Updated core description and procedure to clarify the two-phase workflow: Fix (root cause & improvement) ➔ Resume (complete original work).
- Minor clarifications and editorial enhancements for step breakdown and task management.
- Added `scripts/detect-agent-env.sh` script.
- Removed `skill-card.md` file.

## fix v0.4.0

- Refined rule scope logic: `--local` now covers both `.claude/rules/` and `.agents/AGENTS.md`; clearer rules on project/workspace vs global file locations.
- Explicitly forbids writing to global rules (including `~/.agents/rules/` and `~/.agents/GEMINI.md`) when local mode is set.
- Clarified documentation on rule file precedence, with improved instructions for local/global separation and sync caveats.
- Removed outdated `skill-card.md`; updated docs and procedures to match.
- Documentation and procedural improvements; no user-facing command or interface changes.

Version 0.3.9

- Enforced that a /fix invocation MUST register at least 5+ granular TodoWrite steps (not 4 generic tasks); collapsing into 4 steps is now a HARD STOP.
- Clarified that on chained /fix requests, Resume tasks from incomplete prior fixes must be preserved and included beyond fix-2 (not overwritten).
- Added strict instruction to present trade-off-axis questions (not just disposition choices) via AskUserQuestion after emitting a plan artifact, especially with --plan or any unresolved review axes.
- Improved clarity on options for `--plan` and `--local`, and clarified routed behaviors and fallback mechanisms.
- Updated topics and procedural documentation for consistency and to reflect new behavior on plan approval, question sequencing, and artifact handling.
- Removed: obsolete skill-card.md.
